children: Algorhythm Holdings ended its July 21, 2026 stock-for-debt settlement agreement with Continuation Capital on September 21, 2026, by mutual consent. The termination cancels any further obligation to issue up to 5,000,000 shares that would have continued until Continuation Capital generated proceeds equal to 120% of the $1,928,014 claim. The company estimates approximately $1,418,649 remains due under the underlying liabilities. No termination fees were disclosed; the move reduces near-term equity issuance overhang.
: End further share issuance; reassess liability resolution
